What is the annual fees on the Mashreq Platinum Plus Credit Card?
Platinum Plus Primary Credit Card fee is AED 299 + 5% VAT and Supplementary card is free for life. This annual fee will be charged immediately upon credit card activation.
How do I earn and redeem rewards on my Platinum Plus Credit Card?

For every local or international transaction made with your Mashreq Platinum Plus Credit Card, you will earn Mashreq Vantage reward points. You can redeem them instantly via Mashreq Mobile App or at a partner merchant. To know more visit mashreq.com/vantage.
How many complimentary airport lounge access visits can I get in a year? Is there a spend criteria to receive this benefit?

You can enjoy 4 complimentary airport lounge visits in a calendar year. You need to make total retail purchases of AED 7,000 or more on your Platinum Plus Card in the previous month’s statement to receive this service in the following month.
Visits are applicable for the cardholder or the cardholder and guest (only one complimentary guest per visit)
Will all spends be eligible for the total purchase amount required to take advantage of complimentary benefits like Lounge Access, Movie Benefits etc?

All purchases on your Platinum Plus Credit Card, including Supplementary, will be eligible and counted against the minimum purchase amount required to enjoy the complimentary benefits. Bank Fee/Charges, Cash advances and Balance Transfer/Easy Cash transactions will not be counted under the minimum purchase amount.

You will get 15% & 10% discount of up to AED 300 & AED 80 respectively on eligible hotel & flight bookings. In addition, you will also receive 15% bonus on hotel (up to AED 300) and 10% bonus on flight booking (up to AED 80) credited to your MMT wallet (Valid for 60 days).
Please note, minimum booking amount is AED 600 for flight booking and AED 300 for hotel booking.
How do I check my Mashreq Vantage points balance?
Simply log in to the Mashreq Mobile App and select Mashreq Vantage Rewards Program. To view your points statement, you can select ‘View Mashreq Vantage Summary’.
